description: Drag-and-drop automation builder connecting Google Sheets, WhatsApp templates, Emails, and Voice Agent nodes.

layout_structure.sidebar: Left sidebar containing draggable nodes. Collapsible.
layout_structure.main_area: A large canvas with a subtle dot grid pattern.

canvas_nodes.style: Rounded rectangular cards (radius 8px), white background, subtle shadow.
canvas_nodes.header: Colored strip at the top (Triggers = Blue, Actions = Yellow, Logic = Lavender). Icon + Node Title.
canvas_nodes.ports: Small circular handles on the top/bottom or left/right for connecting edges.

states.error: Border red, small warning triangle icon.

edges.style: Smooth bezier curves (gray stroke, 2px wide) connecting node ports. Arrowhead at the destination.
edges.hover: Stroke becomes Kournikova and slightly thicker.

configuration_drawer.location: Sliding in from the right edge when a node is clicked.
configuration_drawer.content: Specific form inputs for the selected node (e.g., mapping Google Sheet columns to WhatsApp template variables).

visual_prompt_notes: A visual drag-and-drop workflow builder on a dotted canvas background. The canvas shows a flowchart connecting different blocks: A 'Trigger' block (Google Sheet), connected by curved lines to an 'Action' block (WhatsApp Template), which splits into a 'Delay' block and a 'Voice Agent Call' block. The blocks are white cards with colored top-borders (blue, yellow, lavender). A left sidebar shows a menu of draggable nodes. Professional, airy, SaaS aesthetic.
